title: Ensigo y’Okukaayana
intro: Ensi nga tennamanya nti waliwo obutakkaanya obwali buyitiridde, okugezesebwa okw’amaanyi okw’okukkiriza n’obuwulize kwabaawo. Ennyonnyola eno enoonyereza ku kusalawo okukolebwa omuntu ssekinnoomu, ebikolwa bye bye biteekawo ekyokulabirako eri emirembe egijja. Weetegeke okusumulula olugero lw’omwoyo ogulwanagana n’obuggya obw’ekitalo n’ebivaamu eby’amaanyi.
clues: Nnali omu ku baana abaasooka okutambulira ku nsi, omwana w’abantu abasooka ennyo.
Nze ne muganda wange twalagirwa okuwaayo ssaddaaka eri Allah, ekigezo ky’obwesimbu bwaffe.
Ekiweebwayo kyange tekyakkirizibwa, ate ekya muganda wange kyakkirizibwa, ekyajjuza omutima gwange enneewulira ey’entiisa.
Nnayogera ebigambo eby’okutiisatiisa muganda wange, nga nvugibwa obusungu obw’okugaanibwa.
Muganda wange yaddamu n’amagezi n’okutya Katonda, ng’anzijukiza obwenkanya bwa Allah n’okumutya.
Wadde nga muganda wange yayogera ebigambo ebigonvu era nga mwetegefu okusonyiwa, nnatwala obulamu, ne nfuuka omu ku baafiirwa.
arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
